description: Play unrated hosted practice matches and wait for the outcome: each robot's result, placement, how the match ended, damage dealt and taken, its last status, and where to read the match turn by turn. robots lists yours (they play their draft, uncommitted changes included, as a private draft revision; list a held robot in competing to seat its competing revision); opponents takes robot IDs or a house tier, "entry", "middle" or "top", which picks a house robot of that tier. mode and ruleset default to 2d classic and resourceMode to the first class every robot plays (standard, reflex, then open); games and count queue a batch. Still playing when the wait ends: call again with the matchIds it returns. If a call is interrupted, check matches with scope "mine" before queueing again.

drones.description: Let robots whose bot.json names a drone program launch it (default off; docs page "drones")

games.description: Games to queue; replaces mode and ruleset

objective.description: Add king of the hill or pickups (default none)

opponents.description: Robot IDs, or entry, middle or top

seed.description: One match only, or one per game

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 40, at most 55; 0 returns at once)

working.description: false plays your robots' saved revisions instead of their working copies

name: practice_match
